opening.argument: The speaker presents BitClub Network mining as a paid opportunity: viewers are told they are “buying mining hardware” and receiving shares of Bitcoin mining, with a minimum $600 contribution returning on investment in about 300 days. He then says the contract lasts 1,000 days, leaving the remainder “to be in profit.” Viewers are directed to join through an invitation and description link, obtain a Bitcoin wallet, and buy Bitcoin, while the account display shows a mining-related balance and a Bitcoin destination-address field. The speaker also describes reinvesting all stated profit and Bitcoin earnings. Nothing establishes that any payment, withdrawal, or projected return actually occurred.
